name: APEX Signature
description:
APEX Signature allows you to capture signatures and initials with customizable tools, timestamps, save templates, and sign documents. Features include drawing with color/thickness controls, image upload, webcam capture, undo/redo, eraser mode, date/time overlay, initials mode, saved signature templates, and document signing with PDF overlay.

Version 3.5.0 New Features:

  • Initials Mode: Compact component for capturing initials/rubrics
  • Draw or Type modes for initials
  • Auto-generate initials from full name
  • 5 stylized fonts for typed initials
  • Validation: required, minimum strokes

Version 3.4.0 Features:

  • Timestamp Overlay: Date/time with audit info

Version 3.3.0 Features:

  • Customization Toolbar: Color, thickness, eraser, undo/redo

Version 3.2.0 Features:

  • Signature Templates: Save and reuse signatures

Version 3.1.0 Features:

  • Document Signing: PDF/image with signature overlay

Version 3.0.0 Features:

  • Multi-Input Capture: Draw, Upload, Webcam
